title: Interactions of nanoparticles with living and synthetic bio-membranes
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, 54,10531-10615
DOI: 10.1039/D5CS00841G, Review Article
Rashad Kariuki, Kalpani A. Mirihana, Rowan Penman, Andrew Hung, Nastaran Meftahi, Gary Bryant, Paul A. Ramsland, Kislon Voïtchovsky, Charlotte E. Conn, Claudia Contini, Saffron J. Bryant, Andrew J. Christofferson, Aaron Elbourne
This review aims to unify the current literature regarding the biophysical interactions that exist between metal, organic, and inorganic nanoparticles with bio-membrane interfaces, including living and synthetic systems.
